title: Carrying It
summary: Two colleagues talk about the weight navigators carry and the supports, from caseloads to kind boundaries, that help the work last.
learningObjective: Two colleagues talk about the weight navigators carry and the supports, from caseloads to kind boundaries, that help the work last.

sources.title: National Child Traumatic Stress Network — Secondary Traumatic Stress: A Fact Sheet for Child-Serving Professionals (2011)

turns.speaker: host1
turns.text: Navigators hear hard stories all day, often from their own community. That has a name: secondary traumatic stress. The National Child Traumatic Stress Network describes it as distress that comes from hearing about someone else's trauma.

turns.speaker: host1
turns.text: Exhaustion, trouble sleeping, hopelessness, getting cynical, avoiding the people you serve. And the risk goes up with things that fit this work: heavy caseloads, isolation, a lot of empathy and feeling unprepared.

turns.speaker: geffen
turns.text: And then there's the phone. Community members calling at night, on weekends, at the grocery store.

turns.speaker: host1
turns.text: Boundary strain. Saying no can feel like letting your own people down. But a kind boundary protects the relationship. Something like, I want to help with this. I'm off now, so let's talk tomorrow at nine. If it's an emergency, call this number.

turns.speaker: geffen
turns.text: Is this mostly on the navigator, then? Self-care?

turns.speaker: host1
turns.text: Most of it is on the organization. The fact sheet names balanced caseloads, flexible scheduling, ongoing training and supervision. Nobody can self-care their way out of a caseload that doubled.

turns.speaker: geffen
turns.text: So if I supervise a navigator who's gone quiet and is missing follow-ups?

turns.speaker: host1
turns.text: Meet privately, say what you've noticed without labeling, ask how they're carrying it and look at the caseload together. And make sure they know about confidential help, like the Employee Assistance Program.

turns.speaker: geffen
turns.text: Notice early, share the load and set boundaries kindly. That's how the work lasts.
